title: Access configuration
statement: Given a Boolean input $y$, an access state $s$, and natural numbers $i,k,p$, define a four-work-tape configuration on input $y$ with state $s$, input-head position $1$, empty output, and work-tape contents indexed by $r\in\{0,1,2,3\}$ equal to the buffered binary representation of the $r$th entry of $(i,0,k,p)$. The head on work tape $2$ is at position $q$ and the other work-tape heads are at position $0$, where $q$ defaults to $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Integer head position parameter $q$, defaulting to $0$
